style: 巨鲸体内，肋架与连续有机膜面

rules.title: 鲸腹
rules.scatter_rule: 肋架基准130U节距乘0.83–1.18；软组织起伏与硬残骸接地分开。
rules.junction_rule: 公共体腔扩大后分离管道；禁止多个肋环互穿，分离位置由通路与支撑决定。
rules.top_rule: 有机曲面与肋架分工；不能用方房间顶替有机穹面。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: narrow ribs, asymmetric ribs, healed ribs
smooth membrane, wrinkled membrane, transition membrane
tendon, soft nodule, folded tissue, subtle vein
ship plank, small wreckage group, coral-like fragment
kit.root_policy: Soft tissue attaches to enclosing membrane; hard wreckage is grounded. Do not make rigid objects pulse with tissue or flatten ribs into a rectangular ceiling.
kit.assembly: Organic ceiling skin behind ribs every 5.395-7.67m. Soft pulse only if shared socket transforms keep attachments connected; initial static implementation preferred.
kit.light_fx: Preserve restrained warm organic environment and reference emissive accents. Character tint weaker than environment; no additional red combat wash.
kit.junction: One widened common cavity transitioning into separate tubes. Rib supports outside all routes; no crossing full rib rings.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
